idea-plugin.name: Ruby Portable
idea-plugin.description:
Write & run Ruby in IntelliJ IDEA Community — for free. Ruby Portable adds lightweight Ruby support to the free IDE, with no RubyMine license and no system-wide Ruby install required. IntelliJ IDEA Community doesn't bundle the official Ruby plugin (that's Ultimate / RubyMine only), so this fills the gap.

  • Portable Ruby — download a self-contained interpreter from inside the IDE (like the JDK downloader). Stored under ~/.ruby-portable with its own isolated GEM_HOME, so nothing touches a system Ruby, rbenv, rvm or your shell profile. Pick a version and switch anytime.
  • Run with one click — a green ▶ gutter marker and right-click ▸ Run. In a project with a Gemfile the script runs under bundle exec from the Gemfile's directory, so gems and relative paths resolve the way they do in a terminal; elsewhere it's a plain ruby script.rb.
  • Code intelligence (optional) — completion, go-to-definition, hover docs and diagnostics via ruby-lsp, Shopify's Ruby language server, bridged with the free LSP4IJ plugin. One click installs it as a gem into your portable interpreter. Fully offline; no Node.js.
  • Syntax highlighting — for .rb files (keywords, symbols, string and %w literals, string interpolation, instance/class/global variables, regexes, heredocs and comments), even without the language server.
  • Run gem & bundler — bundle install / update / exec, gem install / list, and rake in a console.

macOS and Linux can download an interpreter in-IDE. On Windows, point the plugin at an existing Ruby with Add from Disk… — a bundled download is not offered yet because no relocatable Windows build is published in a format the IDE can unpack.

Active on IDEs without built-in Ruby (IDEA Community, PyCharm Community, WebStorm, …). On RubyMine / IDEA Ultimate the native Ruby support is used instead — this plugin steps aside.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
0.1.0
  • Initial release.
  • Download a self-contained portable Ruby from inside the IDE (macOS / Linux), isolated under ~/.ruby-portable with its own GEM_HOME.
  • Run a .rb file: ▶ gutter marker, bundle exec ruby from the Gemfile's directory when there is one, plain ruby otherwise.
  • Optional ruby-lsp code intelligence via LSP4IJ (one-click setup), lexer-based syntax highlighting, and a bundler / gem / rake runner.
